html: † עַדְרִיאֵל n.pr.m. son-in-law of Saul (appar. Aramaic name, my help is God = Heb. עַזְרִיאֵל q.v.; so NesAm. Jour. Sem. Lang. xiii (1897), 173 HPS cf. GrayProp. N. 309; cf. Old Aramaic יעדראל ClGannJAs 1883. Fev.–Mar., 139, No. 13);—1 S 18:19 (𝔊 A Ιηλ, 𝔊L Εδριηλ), 2 S 21:8 (𝔊 Σερει, A Εσδρι, 𝔊L Εζρι).
